title: RHEL Server Patch with Pre and Post Verification
description: Patches a RHEL server by verifying pre-patch memory and disk space, updating all packages, rebooting, and verifying post-patch system health with a final report.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the RHEL server to patch.

parameters.name: min_free_memory_mb
parameters.description: Minimum free memory required before patching. Recommended value is 2048 MB (2 GB).

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free disk space required on each filesystem. Recommended value is 5 GB.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: reboot_timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the server to come back up after reboot. Recommended value is 120 seconds.

parameters.name: update_timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the package update to complete. Recommended value is 120 seconds.

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Name of the package(s) to update. Default is '*' for all packages.

playbook_output.description: Emits pre-patch memory status, pre-patch disk status, update status, reboot status, post-patch memory status, post-patch disk status, service comparison status, and mismatch list.

fields.name: pre_patch_memory_status
fields.description: Status of the pre-patch memory check (PASS or FAIL with details).

fields.name: pre_patch_disk_status
fields.description: Status of the pre-patch disk space check (PASS or FAIL with details).

fields.name: update_status
fields.description: Status of the package update operation (SUCCESS or FAILED).

fields.name: reboot_status
fields.description: Status of the reboot operation (SUCCESS or FAILED).

fields.name: post_patch_memory_status
fields.description: Status of the post-patch memory check (PASS or FAIL with details).

fields.name: post_patch_disk_status
fields.description: Status of the post-patch disk space check (PASS or FAIL with details).

fields.name: service_comparison_status
fields.description: Status of the service list comparison (MATCH or MISMATCH).

fields.name: mismatch_list
fields.description: Comma-separated list of services that differ between pre-patch and post-patch states.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts including free memory from the target server before patching.

steps.name: Check pre-patch free memory
steps.function: Branch on whether the pre-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Pre-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Collect disk space information for all filesystems, excluding mount points in fs_exclude_list and filesystem types in fs_type_exclude_list.

steps.name: Check pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether any filesystem has insufficient free disk space.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Collect pre-patch running services
steps.function: Collect the list of all running systemd services before patching.

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Update all packages on the target server using the package manager with a timeout.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target server and wait for it to come back up.

steps.name: Verify server is reachable after reboot
steps.function: Branch on whether the server is reachable after the reboot.
steps.condition: The server is reachable after reboot.

steps.name: Gather post-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts including free memory from the target server after patching.

steps.name: Evaluate post-patch memory status
steps.function: Format the post-patch memory check result as PASS or FAIL with details.

computations._post_patch_memory_status: Format the post-patch memory check result as PASS or FAIL with details based on min_free_memory_mb.

steps.name: Check post-patch free memory
steps.function: Branch on whether the post-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Post-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.

steps.name: Gather post-patch disk space
steps.function: Collect disk space information for all filesystems, excluding mount points in fs_exclude_list and filesystem types in fs_type_exclude_list, after patching.

steps.name: Check post-patch disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether any filesystem has insufficient free disk space after patching.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Collect post-patch running services
steps.function: Collect the list of all running systemd services after patching.

steps.name: Compare pre-patch and post-patch service lists
steps.function: Compare the pre-patch and post-patch service lists to identify any mismatches.

computations._service_mismatch: Identify services that differ between _pre_services and _post_services, joined with commas.
computations._service_comparison_status: Set to 'MATCH' if _pre_services and _post_services are identical, otherwise 'MISMATCH'.

steps.name: Check service list mismatch
steps.function: Branch on whether the post-patch service list does not match the pre-patch service list.
steps.condition: The post-patch service list does not match the pre-patch service list.

steps.name: Build final report data
steps.function: Assemble all status fields and results into the final report structure.

computations._pre_patch_memory_status: Format the pre-patch memory check result as PASS or FAIL with details.
computations._pre_patch_disk_status: Format the pre-patch disk space check result as PASS or FAIL with details.
computations._update_status: Format the package update result as SUCCESS or FAILED.
computations._reboot_status: Format the reboot result as SUCCESS or FAILED.
computations._post_patch_disk_status: Format the post-patch disk space check result as PASS or FAIL with details.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Collect system state and validate memory and disk space prerequisites before applying changes.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Apply the package updates and reboot the target server.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Verify memory, disk space, and service state after the patch and reboot.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Build and emit the structured final report to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
